facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa, citing Africa Cybersecurity Magazine, says Mali is among 37 of 54 African countries with national personal data protection laws; it says enforcement remains a hurdle in several countries (published 2025-04-16, no event date given).
facts.system: Loi n°2013-015 du 21 mai 2013 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Benin's APDP said on 15 April 2025 that it signed a cooperation agreement with its Malian counterpart, covering best-practice exchange and joint handling of complaints and compliance checks.
